categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a schedule to an order made under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action by the Minister exercising powers vested by statute to modify existing regulations. While a minister is named, the core content is about modifying the legal framework (adding new degree programs and their abbreviations to a formal schedule) rather than being about the minister's appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
